name: Eldora UI
summary: Free MIT animated React landing-page components via shadcn registry.
gaps: Pilot includes 12 free UI items of ~40 registry:ui entries (115 total registry items incl. examples) — not a full inventory.
Some llms.txt-listed comps (marquee, holographic-card, orbit-rotation, animated-grid-pattern, svg-ripple-effect) returned docs HTTP 404 at research time — excluded; registry JSON may still 200.
Import paths are @/components/eldoraui/{slug}; export names vary (default vs named — PhotonBeam, Cobe, Novatrix, BlurIn, DockText).
photon-beam docs show URL-form install; others prefer @eldoraui/{slug} namespace.
iframe demos only; no dynamic-import smoke mounts in this packet.
Heavy peers on some comps (three for photon-beam / cobe-globe / novatrix).

components.name: Photon Beam
components.summary: WebGL background with animated light trails, bloom, and customizable colors.

demo.peerNotes: Needs three (react). Docs also show URL install: npx shadcn@latest add "https://eldoraui.site/r/photon-beam".

components.copyCode:
npx shadcn@latest add "https://eldoraui.site/r/photon-beam"

import PhotonBeam from "@/components/eldoraui/photon-beam"

<PhotonBeam />

copyPrompt.text: Use Eldora UI free component `Photon Beam` (slug `photon-beam`) from https://www.eldoraui.site/docs/components/photon-beam. Install with `npx shadcn@latest add "https://eldoraui.site/r/photon-beam"` after `npx shadcn@latest init`. Registry item: https://eldoraui.site/r/photon-beam.json. Import path after CLI follows project aliases (see docs). Requires React + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS; peers: Needs three (react).
